                    t+=1

d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def load():
    G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

def objs(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);seen=set();res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); cells=[]; seen.add((r,c))
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and g[na][nb]==col and (na,nb) not in seen:

                res.append((col,cells,min(x for x,_ in cells),max(x for x,_ in cells),min(y for _,y in cells),max(y for _,y in cells)))
